description: Make one issue depend on another issue. The issue identified by index will depend on depends_on_index. The dependency may live in a different repository (cross-repo): pass depends_on_owner/depends_on_repo, which default to owner/repo. This tool fails if the repository has disabled issue dependencies.

depends_on_index.description: Issue index that the given issue should depend on

depends_on_owner.description: Owner of the repository the dependency issue lives in (defaults to owner)

depends_on_repo.description: Repository the dependency issue lives in (defaults to repo)

name: add_issue_dependency
